architectural_references.published_facts: Two-story standalone dining court on Stadium Avenue/Russell corner per Purdue Archives; dining web page confirms use. GIS lists 4 level-related fields (15.3m,27.8m), conflicting with archival 2-story description; model uses 2 visible dining levels, roof height approximate. Roof form follows online exterior image reference with steep traditional gables.

notes: Rechecked Purdue/FRP exterior references and kept the confirmed clay-tile gabled form while modestly reducing overhang and ridge prominence; exact pitch intersections remain uncertain.
Widened the visible dining glazing, added entrance signage, warm table/chair silhouettes and a lower-angle preview to make the occupied two-story commons read clearly.
Kept the two-story source reading and GIS outline; dining furniture and exact roof geometry are schematic.

Added a warm schematic vestibule cue behind the glazed entry, plus a short entry walk and paired low planters. Interior room layout, site furniture, and planting placement are interpretive, not survey-derived.
